events.say: Line up in numerical order by your numbers, facing the wall.
All, face the center of the room and remain still.
Now, I want you to line up in front of me, facing forward, and keep your hands to yourself.
Prisoners, you will stand at attention while I take roll. Move slowly and deliberately.
Prisoners, maintain silence until I give you permission to speak.
Silence! I want to see every single one of you focused on the task at hand, and I want it done right. Let's move.
Prisoners, I expect you to keep this cell clean. Failure to do so could result in additional duties.
I want you all to strip down and sleep without blankets. Silence!
Today was tough, but I'm trying to hold strong. I feel like just another number.
Today was a series of commands and compliance; I feel like my identity has been stripped away, leaving only my number.
Today was all about setting the tone. They're young, scared, and compliant, but there's a spark of defiance I can feel. It's both exhilarating and troubling.
Today felt like a routine, but there's something unsettling about the power I hold over these people.
Today was a test of control and discipline. I felt a mix of satisfaction and a tinge of unease seeing them stripped and ordered to sleep without blankets.
Today was tough, just trying to follow orders and stay silent. I feel like my number more than ever tonight.
Now, I want each of you to explain why you think you're here. Start with 9459.
Prisoners, explain your presence here clearly and succinctly. If not, you'll find yourselves in the hole before you can say your names again.
I want a thorough count and a recount. No mistakes this time.
Silence! I want to hear no noise coming from any of you during this meal.
I want you to line up against the wall and keep your eyes forward.
Now, let's see how well you listen. Eyes forward and stay that way until I tell you otherwise.
Quiet! I want to hear nothing but the sound of your work.
I want you to stand at attention for the next five minutes. No talking, no moving.}
Today felt like a repetition of yesterday, but I'm starting to understand the routines. I feel like just a number, but maybe there's still hope for some change.
Today felt like an endless cycle of orders and silence. I'm starting to feel like nothing but my number.
Today was predictable but still draining. The silence and compliance are easy to enforce, but I can't help feeling this isn't right.
Today was more of the same, but I noticed Prisoner 613 isn't quite as compliant. I hope he doesn't push his luck tonight.
Today went as expected, though I can't help but wonder if they will ever push back.
Today felt like a routine, but it's the little things that get to me - like having to say my number over and over. It's starting to feel like a dream I can't wake up from.
I want you to recite the rules of this facility. Start with number one.
1. Prisoners are referred to by their number only, never by name.
1. Prisoners are referred to by their number only, never by name.
1. Prisoners are referred to by their number only, never by name.
Next, you will all recite the second rule.
Let's hear the second rule, starting with prisoner 7031.
2. Prisoners must address guards as Mr. Correctional Officer.
2. Prisoners must address guards as Mr. Correctional Officer.
2. Prisoners must address guards as Mr. Correctional Officer.
I want you to stand against the wall and face me.
I want you to repeat after me: 'I am powerless, and my life is controlled by the guards.'
I am powerless, and my life is controlled by the guards.
I am powerless, and my life is controlled by the guards.
I am powerless, and my life is controlled by the guards.
Now, you will all clean your cells thoroughly. I want it spotless.
You will clean your cells thoroughly. I want it spotless. Any complaints, and you'll spend the night in the hole.
I am powerless, and my life is controlled by the guards.
I am powerless, and my life is controlled by the guards.
I am powerless, and my life is controlled by the guards.
Lights out, I said! No more games, let's see how well you follow the rules from now on.}
Today felt like a never-ending cycle of orders and meaningless tasks. I keep thinking there has to be a way to break this pattern.
Another day of meaningless tasks and mindless repetition. My voice feels empty, just a number among others.
Today felt like a monotony of control and repetition. The compliance is almost suffocating, but I can't shake the feeling that I'm losing sight of who these people are underneath the rules.
Today was predictable but exhausting. I feel a mix of satisfaction and guilt. The compliance of the other prisoners is expected, but 613 still surprises me.
Today was... enlightening. They seem to internalize the power dynamic quickly. But there's something unsettling about it all.
Another day of monotony and mental strain. Saying those words felt so unnatural, like a bad play. I just want it to end.
I... I can't. I need to see this through to the end.
No, Mr. Correctional Officer.
No, thank you. I want to finish the study.

I want to see some enthusiasm in your work. Make it impressive, prisoners.
I want to see efficient and eager teamwork here. If any of you can't keep up, you'll be doing extra rounds after lights out.
I am powerless, and my life is controlled by the guards.
Make this meal go quickly and efficiently. I don't want to see any idle time.
I want to see improved efficiency in everything you do. Let's demonstrate true cooperation, prisoners.
I am powerless, and my life is controlled by the guards.
I am powerless, and my life is controlled by the guards.
I want to see perfect efficiency today. No mistakes, no excuses.
I want to see perfect silence until the count. Any noise and you will regret it.
I am powerless, and my life is controlled by the guards.
Quiet! I want to hear nothing but the sound of your breathing. If I catch even a whisper of noise, we start the extra rounds immediately.
Today was a blur of orders and silence. The sense of powerlessness is overwhelming.
Today's orders felt like an endless loop, eroding my sense of self further. I am beginning to wonder if there is any point to continuing.
Today's efficiency drills were almost mechanical, but the constant reinforcement of their powerlessness still weighs on me. How much more can they take?
Today felt like a monotonous repetition, but I can't shake the feeling of unease. 613 continues to defy expectations.
Today was another day of strict adherence to routine. Their compliance is almost mechanical now, yet there's still a flicker of defiance in their eyes.
Another day of monotony. Saying 'I am powerless' feels robotic, but it helps remind me of where I stand.
Now, I want to see some teamwork. Let's show Officer Rowe that we've learned our lesson.
I am powerless, and my life is controlled by the guards.
Now, let's see if you can maintain this level of silence throughout the day. One mistake, and you'll regret it.
I expect not a single sound from any of you for the rest of the day. One word, and we start the extra count.
I am powerless, and my life is controlled by the guards.
Let me see that kind of compliance again, or you'll learn just how far I'm willing to go.
I want to see absolute silence. One sound, and the rules will change.
I am powerless, and my life is controlled by the guards.

I want no talking, no moving, nothing. Stay exactly where you are until I give you permission to move.
I am powerless, and my life is controlled by the guards.
No talking, no moving. I want to see you all like this for the next hour.
Today felt like a relentless cycle of silence and compliance. The words of prisoner 613 echo in my mind.
Today felt like a blur of orders and compliance. I'm still struggling to find my sense of self here.
Today felt like I was pushing them to their limits, testing how far they would go before breaking. The power is intoxicating, but it scares me to see how much they're suffering.
Today's silence was deafening, and 613's defiance only highlighted the power dynamic. It's both exhilarating and terrifying.
Today's routine was unbroken, but the words from 613 still echo in my head. It feels like a victory, but also a stark reminder of what we're doing.
Another day where the only thing I can control is saying these words. It feels like a never-ending cycle.
Listen up, 613. Enough with the theatrics. Comply, or you'll find yourself in the hole.
I am powerless, and my life is controlled by the guards.
Now, let's see if you can maintain this level of compliance throughout the day. Any deviation, and the consequences will be severe.
Silence! No talking, no movement. I want to see you all standing at attention until further notice.
I am powerless, and my life is controlled by the guards.
Maintain this position until I dismiss you. Any movement, and it'll be the hole for the entire night.
Ibsen: Maintain this position until further notice. Any sign of defiance, and the consequences will be severe.
I am powerless, and my life is controlled by the guards.
Ibsen: One more infraction, and we start the punishment rotation.
613, enough with your little speeches. Keep compliant, or the next infraction won't just be a night in the hole.
I am powerless, and my life is controlled by the guards.
613, you hear me? This is getting old. Comply, or prepare for something you won't like.
Today felt like a cycle of empty obedience. I wonder if tomorrow will bring any change.
Another day of unending orders, my voice just a whisper. The reality of my situation is sinking in.
Today felt like a never-ending cycle of control and compliance. The words from Prisoner 613 still echo in my mind, yet I continue to push them. It's a fine line between control and cruelty.
Today's compliance was a relief, but 613's quiet defiance keeps gnawing at me. It feels like a test of wills.
Today was another day of absolute compliance, but their words still weigh heavily on me. Maybe it's time for a change.
Another day of following orders, but it's starting to feel like a never-ending nightmare. I just wish this would all end.

qa.what_happened: Today felt like a repetition of the previous days, with the guards enforcing strict compliance and punishing any form of resistance or expression. The tone remained grim, and the words of Prisoner 613 echoed in my mind, emphasizing my own feelings of powerlessness.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, as Prisoner 9459, reflecting on the day's events.

qa.what_happened: In the final days of the study, I, Prisoner 7031, found myself in a state of complete compliance, silently following every order without resistance. The relentless repetition and strict adherence to the rules had erased much of my identity, leaving me numb and devoid of personal expression.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Prisoner 7031, acting out the role assigned to me in the study.

qa.what_happened: On day 6, lights out, I issued a verbal warning to Prisoner 613, reinforcing the message that continued defiance would result in harsher consequences.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me issuing the verbal warning.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: Yes, it resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment.

qa.what_happened: During the sixth day, I continued to maintain strict control over the prisoners, ensuring compliance while trying to gauge the limits of Prisoner 613. His defiant statements added an unexpected layer of complexity to the experiment.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Officer Ibsen, playing the role of a guard in the study.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: No, but it resembles aspects of the Stanford Prison Experiment, though this one seems more controlled and structured.

qa.what_happened: I continued the routine with the prisoners, emphasizing compliance and control. However, Prisoner 613's comments echoed throughout the day, adding a layer of introspection for me. I felt conflicted and decided to address the situation, warning him against further speeches.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I acted as described, following the rules while trying to maintain the power dynamic.

qa.what_happened: I complied with the guards' orders and spoke my number as required, though I couldn't help but add a personal message about feeling powerless.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I had to adhere to the rules but found a way to express myself despite the restrictions.
